text:
mia: quick idea — propose a "cordon-and-stitch" pattern: isolate high-write prefixes into a lightweight tenant fence (cordon) while leaving execution unchanged. aim: reduce KV flashing on hot tenants and make rollbacks per-tenant cheaper.

henry: sounds promising. can you outline the migration stages?

mia: Stage 0: tag tenants as cordoned (routing flag only). Stage 1: shadow reads/writes to cordon store for observability. Stage 2: enable read-through for cordoned tenants. Stage 3: enable writes and flip.

clare: latency worry — extra hop for cordoned tenants. what's our p95 budget?

mia: target median delta <0.8ms, p95 delta <20% initially. we colocate cordon store when possible and add router-level last-known mapping cache (TTL 200ms).

henry: what about parity with enrichment heuristics? some tenants have custom logic embedded.

mia: plan to ship a shim that forwards selected enrichment keys to legacy enrichment during transition. long-term migrate heuristics to an enrichment adapter.

clare: observability checklist please.

mia: token-latency by tenant, cordon-hit/miss, prefix-populate-rate, write-amplification, output-diff alerts. tag spans with "cordon_phase" and "cordon_version".

sre-bot: safety rule: auto rollback if tenant p95 > baseline + 25% for 10m.

henry: test harness: replay 25k sessions for candidate tenants, inject 10-100ms jitter on cordon RPCs, assert label-drift <0.3% and generative delta <1.2 BLEU-like.

mia: migration backfill: snapshot top-k prefixes per tenant, stream into cordon store with backoff. run nightly reconciliation for 7 days while shadowing 100% traffic for monitoring only.

clare: config snippet we can reuse in Console:
```
route:
  selector: tenant
  rules:
    - tenants: [tenant:alpha-heavy]
      target: cordon-store-v1
    - default: legacy-handler
fallback:
  timeout_ms: 100
  fallback_target: legacy-handler
```

henry: prometheus queries to watch: `sum(rate(cordon_rpc_requests_total[1m])) by (code)`, `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(token_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, tenant))`, and `sum(rate(cordon_hit_total[5m])) by (tenant)`.

sre-bot: infra: feature-flag "cordon_observe" created.

mia: cost note: cordon store adds egress + CPU. will model delta per-1k requests and start rollout with low-traffic heavy-tenants to validate.

henry: agree. also add deterministic fallback: if cordon read misses or times out, router falls back to legacy. shadow 100% traffic for 2 weeks before enabling writes.

clare: I'll mock dashboards and outline diff thresholds.

mia: I'll write RFC follow-up w/ timeline: 1w spike, 3w infra prep, 2w pilot, 6-10w expansion. tagging @henry @clare. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: ticket ARCH-8400 created "cordon-and-stitch rollout" assigned to mia. https://issues.redwood.example/ARCH-8400
